delivery_label: Unterjährige Datenlieferung DRG Januar bis Dezember 2025
cohort: Acute OPS-defined cohort; adults aged 18 years or older

endpoint.description: Registered diagnosis endpoint key. volume_depletion means E86 secondary-diagnosis coding; it is not specific for low-intake dehydration.

analysis.description: Name of the directly standardized model.

all_n.description: Total adult cases retained on model-specific common support.

dys_n.description: Dysphagia-coded cases retained on model-specific common support.

no_dys_n.description: Complement cases without the selected R13 coding, retained on model-specific common support.

crude_rr_same_population.description: Crude coded-outcome risk ratio in exactly the same common-support population as the standardized model.

dys_standardized_risk.description: Pooled-weight standardized probability in the dysphagia-coded group (0–1 scale).

no_dys_standardized_risk.description: Pooled-weight standardized probability in the comparator group (0–1 scale).

rr_ci_lower.description: Lower approximate 95% confidence limit for the standardized RR.

rr_ci_upper.description: Upper approximate 95% confidence limit for the standardized RR.

risk_difference.description: Standardized dysphagia risk minus comparator risk on the probability scale; multiply by 100 for percentage points.

risk_difference_ci_lower.description: Lower approximate 95% confidence limit for the risk difference on the probability scale.

risk_difference_ci_upper.description: Upper approximate 95% confidence limit for the risk difference on the probability scale.

analysis_role.description: Primary, descriptive PCCL sensitivity, or secondary model designation.

interval_qualification.description: Interval limitations including qualitative sparsity/boundary flags, without stratum counts.

severity_qualification.description: Interpretation limitations concerning NIHSS, residual confounding and PCCL.

pccl_grouping.description: Native PCCL levels or not included. No coarsened-PCCL E86 model is reported.

provenance: Three model-level rows from the joint pipeline, independently recalculated from original workbooks using 60-digit Decimal arithmetic. No private strata or source hash mapping included.
